SB 1174 (Min, 2024) bars local governments from requiring a person to show identification to vote in a local election. She voted yes on the Senate floor (30-8-2). Source is CalMatters Digital Democracy.

AB 1116 (Berman) requires the Secretary of State, by 2029, to build a way to collect an electronic signature image from someone who registers to vote online without a California driver's license or ID card. She voted yes on the Senate floor. Source is CalMatters Digital Democracy.

findings.passage: Senator Smallwood-Cuevas shared what the State Legislature is doing to protect voting rights in California, including their fight against a Republican measure headed for the November ballot that would add photo ID and proof-of-citizenship requirements to the state constitution. If it passes, it would be difficult for lawmakers to change since it’s a constitutional amendment. “That’s why we have to act now. Our best defense to being silenced is to strengthen protections for all Californian voters,”
